eligible_population_definition: All rows in data/clean_articles.csv whose Index (0-based corpus row id) has a non-empty Headline after strip with length >= 12 characters, AND whose Index is not in the source_doc_id set of experiments/phase2_oracle/oracle_all.csv (QTRN_001 through QTRN_260). Eligible n=111574 after excluding 260 QTRN source ids and short/empty headlines. Sampling: Python random.Random(120260827), stratified by Category bucket (sports / business / entertainment / science/tech / general) with quota 8 per bucket. The corpus Category column has only Sports, Business & Economics, Entertainment, and Science & Technology (no General), so the general quota was 0; the remaining 8 slots were filled from the leftover eligible pool shuffled with the same RNG. All 40 sampled source_doc_id values are unique. Among sampled headlines that contain Urdu letters and no Latin letters, the same RNG shuffled indices and assigned the first 12 to ordinary Roman Urdu title-like queries; the rest remain Urdu-script title-like queries. MIXED was not forced. Source selection did not use BM25, MiniLM, or any ranker. Subset U was written from naturalistic information-need quotas without corpus search and without source_doc_id.
k_script_assignment: 12 ordinary Roman Urdu; remainder Urdu script; MIXED not forced
detector_function: Unicode script-count detector identical to experiments/phase5_roman_urdu/run_phase5.py detect_script; counts only, no ranking
